newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela GDP up more than 1 pct in Q1 -- Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela GDP up more than 1 pct in Q1 -- Matos.

text.p: Venezuela's economy has reversed its one percent fall in gross domestic product of the last quarter of 1996 and is set to bounce back in the first quarter of 1997, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said.
"The economy is growing above one percent of GDP in this first quarter, when compared to the last quarter of 1996," Matos told reporters.
"We are going to have growth with low inflation ... there are already positive results," he said.
Matos added that a recent 75 percent average public sector wage increase deal had been offered "truly within the country's fiscal limits."

However, he added the country's consolidated public sector surplus would likely fall to "two percent of GDP from original targets of 2.7 percent." Matos did not provide forecasts for the central government budget surplus.
In 1996, Venezuela posted a consolidated public sector budget surplus equivalent to 7.3 percent of GDP, according to Central Bank figures.
